data.text: Be gracious to me, God, be gracious to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. In the shadow of your wings I will take refuge until destruction passes.
data.titulo: Refuge and Praise under God's Care
data.subtitulo: For the music director; according to “Do Not Destroy.” A miktam of David, when he fled from Saul into the cave.

data.text: I cry to God Most High, to God who brings things to completion for me.
He will send from heaven and save me; he will put my trampler to shame. Selah. God will send his steadfast love and truth.
My soul is among lions; I lie among fiery men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongue is a sharp sword.
Be exalted above the heavens, God; let your glory be over all the earth.
data.titulo: God's Glory over All the Earth

data.text: They prepared a net for my steps; my soul was bowed down. They dug a pit before me, but fell into it themselves. Selah.
My heart is steadfast, God, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and make music.
data.titulo: A Steadfast Heart Awakes to Praise

data.text: Awake, my glory! Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
I will thank you among the peoples, Lord; I will sing praise to you among the nations.
For your steadfast love is great to the heavens, and your truth to the clouds.
Be exalted above the heavens, God; let your glory be over all the earth.
